summary: Your CRM: people, companies and deals.
features: Your CRM: people, companies and deals.
requirements: A Attio account with permission to use its MCP server
Node.js and npm to run the server
limits: Available tools and access depend on the upstream server and account permissions
Live account access has not been verified for this extension package
pricing: Your service plan, API access requirements and usage quotas apply; no subscription is included.
privacy: Requests and authorized account data are exchanged with the configured service. Server output may enter agent context as untrusted content.
tagline: Bring people, companies and deals into context
description:
Connect Attio to work with the people, companies and deals available in your CRM. Choose a company or deal and bring its available record information into APX for a focused review of the customer relationship.

Keep people, company and deal records distinct when names overlap: the selected record is the anchor for follow-up questions. Attio's current tools and your account permissions determine the available fields and actions. Reviewing information does not require changing the pipeline, and your Attio subscription remains separate from the extension.
prompts: Review the company record I select in Attio.
Read the available details of the selected Attio deal without changing its stage.
Summarize the business information in the person record I choose.

features: Personas, empresas y oportunidades de tu CRM.

Node.js y npm para ejecutar el servidor

es.tagline: Poné personas, empresas y negocios en contexto
es.description:
Conectá Attio para trabajar con las personas, empresas y negocios disponibles en tu CRM. Elegí una empresa o un negocio y traé su información disponible a APX para revisar la relación comercial con un foco claro.

Distinguí los registros de personas, empresas y negocios cuando compartan nombres: el registro elegido guía las preguntas siguientes. Las herramientas actuales de Attio y los permisos de tu cuenta determinan campos y acciones disponibles. Revisar información no requiere cambiar el pipeline, y tu suscripción de Attio sigue separada de la extensión.
prompts: Revisá el registro de empresa que elija en Attio.
Leé los detalles disponibles del negocio elegido de Attio sin cambiar su etapa.
Resumí la información comercial del registro de persona que seleccione.
